purpose: Per-class disposition for every out-of-package tcrn-* class found by the first run of scripts/doc-shell-class-proof.mjs (TCRN-DS-SUB-024). This map is the only input for SUB-025, SUB-026 and SUB-027, which clear the gate to zero.

dispositions.delete-package-provided: The class is written onto a package component, or the doc layer copies a package component or variant. Delete the class and its doc rules; render the package component with its own props. A variant the package lacks goes to the package, not back into the doc layer.
dispositions.rename-tcrn-doc: rename→tcrn-doc-*: documentation scaffolding that only arranges package components or doc text. Rename the class to target in markup, doc CSS, proofs and tests; keep the rules under the new name.
dispositions.delete-demo: Storybook-only imitation of product UI that the package does not provide. Delete the markup and its doc rules; where a story still needs the pattern, compose it from package components.
dispositions.delete-dead: No effect: defined but never written, or written with no rule anywhere and no proof hook. Delete the rule or the class token.

fields.definedIn: doc CSS rule locations (file:line), from apps/storybook/src
fields.usedIn: doc source locations that write the class (file:line)
fields.renderedPageCount: built static pages (apps/storybook/storybook-static) whose markup or scripts carry the class; renderedPages lists up to three
fields.references: proof and test locations (scripts/, tests/, apps/storybook/src/*.test.ts) that name the class and must change with it
